name: teron-ecosystem
description: Monorepo para orquestração local do Ecossistema Teron (Bot + Painel + Workspace)

scripts.dev: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue" -n "OS,WORKSPACE,BOT,PANEL" "npm run dev:os" "npm run dev:workspace" "npm run dev:bot" "npm run dev:bot:panel"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix teron-os && npm install --prefix teron-workspace && npm install --prefix bot
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix teron-os && npm run build --prefix teron-workspace && npm run build --prefix bot
